notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Famished Foragers.
When Famished Foragers dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Famished Foragers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Famished Foragers' power.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Famished Foragers' ability to infinitely rummage.
